prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
For a **custom, natural-looking spray tan**, **Gorgeous GLO Beauty Bar** looks like a strong pick: reviews highlight personalized color matching, helpful guidance, and a comfortable experience. [Website](https://www.gorgeousglo.com/) · [Reviews](https://www.yelp.com/biz/gorgeousglo-beauty-bar-charlotte)

If you mean **tanning beds as well as spray tans**, **Palm Beach Tan** has several Charlotte locations and a broader range of services, though reviews vary by location. [Charlotte locations](https://palmbeachtan.com/locations/nc/charlotte-east-woodlawn-road)

“Best” depends on the kind of tanning you want and which part of Charlotte you’re in. I’d check recent reviews and call ahead to confirm services and pricing.
